agents_ran_as: Simulated named reviewers in-session; multi-agent tool was not used because the user did not explicitly request delegation.

creative_editor_1.protects: The public zodiac recognition while refusing zodiac-symbol visuals.
creative_editor_1.cuts: Any slide where he is merely boring and she is merely chaos.
creative_editor_1.repair: Make the emotional thesis about pace, not personality labels.

creative_editor_2.protects: The user-supplied lines because they already have clean swipe rhythm.
creative_editor_2.cuts: The word 'plot twist' if visuals cannot prove it with a real turn.
creative_editor_2.repair: Stage every line as a behavior receipt: notebook, door, keys, phone, hands, eye-line.

writer_1.protects: Short public copy and the 'he/she' contrast.
writer_1.repair: Keep copy low-text and let visual action carry meaning.

writer_2.protects: The final 'somehow they make perfect sense' because it is sendable.
writer_2.repair: Make the last visual prove that he is no longer tolerating the spark; he is choosing it.

route_b_checklist_launch_button.creative_editor_1: Strongest physical mechanic, but slightly narrower than the full user-supplied eight-slide polarity.
route_b_checklist_launch_button.creative_editor_2: Good proof engine for slide 1-3, weaker for silence/fighting and stability/spark.
route_b_checklist_launch_button.writer_1: Would make a sharper five-slide deck if we were not honoring the eight-slide request.
route_b_checklist_launch_button.writer_2: Keep as the internal visual repair pattern for Route A.

route_c_screenshots_instinct.creative_editor_1: Very specific and modern, but too small to carry the whole carousel.
route_c_screenshots_instinct.creative_editor_2: Best as a middle beat, not title concept.
route_c_screenshots_instinct.writer_1: Could become too techy unless softened by expressions and body distance.
route_c_screenshots_instinct.writer_2: Use as slide 6 proof exactly as creator supplied.

cross_agent_summary.storyline_architect: Winner should keep all eight creator beats but place them inside one emotional machine: preparation becomes runway, instinct becomes motion, calm becomes chosen participation.
cross_agent_summary.contrarian_critic: Raw astrology contrast is capped as generic unless the visuals prove real action. Route A passes only with staged behavior and no zodiac-symbol poster treatment.
cross_agent_summary.retention_analyst: Slide 1 has a fast public hook because Capricorn/Aries is instantly recognizable. Middle re-engagement must come from screenshots/instinct and silent worry/loud fight, not repeated 'opposites attract.'
cross_agent_summary.visual_director: Use lifestyle scenes across desk, doorway, cafe/table, and phone/checklist details. Keep warm ivory negative space. No literal goats/rams/fire signs, no astrology chart clutter.
cross_agent_summary.copy_chief: Treat supplied copy as near-lock but repair the typo and possibly tighten slide 1. Do not add public Aachu/Zuv names.
cross_agent_summary.algorithm_strategist: The send behavior is partner tagging by identity type: planners send to starters; starters send to planners. Caption should invite 'which one are you?' without becoming generic zodiac content.
cross_agent_summary.final_selector: Select Route A with Route B as its visual mechanic. GO for creator concept lock, not copy lock yet.
